question_text: Each employee holds one role; a role can be held by many employees. Employees can work in many branches and each branch has many employees. Describe the ROLE-to-EMPLOYEE and EMPLOYEE-to-BRANCH relationships.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: ROLE to EMPLOYEE is one-to-many. EMPLOYEE to BRANCH is many-to-many, normally represented through a link table.
